LIM-F.definition_level_part: the implication that stage-local readers agreeing at every stage have equal family verdicts is true by unfolding and carries no content by itself; the content is the exhaustiveness check over the enumerated grammar, which is a real property and can fail

escape.capability_it_must_carry: reading the family up to k rather than the current state; research/second_stake independently classifies such a rule as index-reading and treats it as a negative control
escape.smallest_lifting_admission: a seventh item kind admitting a total function of the finite verdict sequence

LIM-F.proof: no item carries a stage index, an earlier regime, or an earlier verdict, so every admitted reader's stage verdict is a function of that stage's regime alone; a novel family verdict differs from every stage verdict and so is the value of no stage-local reader
LIM-F.statement: no object admissible by the six item kinds realises a function of the finite verdict sequence that is both stable and novel

escape.at_a_given_carrier: buy width: the reader needs at least the base-two logarithm of the carrier, rounded up, contexts
escape.why_no_one_step_price: the requirement grows with the carrier, so the escape is a rate of about log2(n) items and not a one-step price

LIM-G.proof: two data with equal signatures have s = 0 and a(0) is false, so the non-separation relation is coarser than signature equality and has at most 2**w blocks; once the carrier exceeds 2**w some pair is identified
LIM-G.statement: no fixed-selection reader of width w separates every pair once the carrier exceeds two to the power w

LIM-R.countermodel: under the parity aggregation, at the regime with one arity-2 form, no rule and the instance (0,(0,0)), a reader reading where coverage is absent has 2 blocks at one context and 1 block at two: adding a context LOWERS the block count

escape.capability_it_must_carry: either a carrier not equal to the admitted data, or a reader whose non-separation is not an equivalence on the admitted data, which is exactly what lawfulness refuses
escape.smallest_lifting_admission: a seventh item kind, outside the declared alphabet
escape.why: the demand's threshold is stated relative to the carrier and the ceiling tracks the carrier exactly, so admitting data raises both together

LIM-R.narrowing: this tree's own first statement of the proof said every strict split raises the block count for every lawful reader. That is false, and its own test caught it. The statement is narrowed here rather than the wording kept and the receipt leaned on
LIM-R.proof: a lawful reader's induced partition has at least one block and at most n_data blocks; for a MONOTONE aggregation every added context leaves the block count at least where it was, so at most n_data - 1 strict splits occur
LIM-R.proof_reach: the block-count proof covers the MONOTONE lawful aggregations only: 2 of the 4 at width 3, namely the blind one and at-least-one-separating-context. For the other two the block count can FALL when a context is added, and the bound is a bounded computation over the declared population rather than a theorem
LIM-R.statement: no chain of strictly splitting selections is longer than the carrier minus one, so a chain longer than the carrier does not exist at any state
